mutations.note: Drop per-line rstrip normalization; trailing-whitespace-only differences no longer normalize away
Re-enable SequenceMatcher autojunk heuristic, corrupting char-diff counts on texts with frequent characters
min/max swap undercounts differences when texts have unequal lengths
Boundary off-by-one: size-1 file falls through to log curve (ln(1)=0 gives allowed=10) instead of returning 1
Operator match ordering: 'lte'/'gte' tokens now prefix-match 'lt'/'gt' first, parsing the wrong operator and garbage size
lte boundary flip: file exactly at the size limit no longer qualifies for fuzzy matching

mutations.original: if file_len > FUZZY_BIG_FILE_THRESHOLD and not do_big:
mutations.mutated: if file_len > FUZZY_BIG_FILE_THRESHOLD or not do_big:
mutations.note: and/or swap: default small-mode fuzzy matching is disabled for every file, not just big ones
Off-by-one seed: a candidate whose diff exactly equals the threshold is rejected instead of accepted
Size-ratio pre-filter boundary: candidates at exactly 2.0x length ratio are now excluded
Threshold computed from the smaller file, violating the 'larger of the two files' heuristic and tightening acceptance
Canonical pick inverted: chooses the NEWEST instance instead of the oldest, breaking provenance intent
Dropped continue after exact match: exact-matched files fall through into fuzzy matching and get double-counted
